No Result View All Result Home News Politics Business Sport Football Health Entertainment Education Opinion Editorial Columns Others LeVogue Magazine Conferences National Economy Contact Us Hausa Edition Home News Politics Business Sport Football Health Entertainment Education Opinion Editorial Columns Others LeVogue Magazine Conferences National Economy Contact Us No Result View All Result No Result View All Result Tinubu Congratulates Oba Of Benin On 10th Anniversary, 73rd Birthday by Jonathan Nda-Isaiah 9 seconds ago in News Share on WhatsApp Share on Facebook Share on X Telegram President Bola Tinubu has congratulated the Oba of Benin, His Royal Majesty, Ewuare II, on his 10th anniversary on the throne and 73rd birthday.
The President, in a statement personally signed by him, extended his congratulations on behalf of his wife and the Federal Government.
Tinubu described the monarch as an embodiment of enduring dignity, culture and historical consciousness, noting that his leadership reflected the heritage and identity of the Benin people and Nigerians at large.
He said the anniversary marked a decade of royal stewardship, service and commitment to preserving the heritage and traditions of the Benin Kingdom.
“For a decade, you have continued to demonstrate your leadership by sustaining the dignity of the Royal institution and inspiring confidence,” the President said.
Tinubu said he had watched with admiration the wisdom, courage, restraint and commitment to peace that had characterised the monarch’s years on the throne.
According to him, Oba Ewuare II has remained a symbol of grace and integrity, a fountain of wisdom, a guardian of communal values and a rallying point for the aspirations of his people.
The President also commended the traditional ruler’s efforts to repatriate stolen Benin artefacts, describing him as a remarkable custodian of one of Africa’s most enduring monarchies.
As the Oba marked his 73rd birthday, Tinubu prayed for renewed strength, greater wisdom and sound health for the monarch.
He also expressed hope that the new year would inspire younger generations to cherish their cultural heritage and that the monarch’s reign would record greater achievements in the cultural and social causes he had championed.
The President concluded his tribute with the traditional Benin expression, “Oba gha t’o kpere. Ise!”
